title: Ancient Puzzles: Guard Break
summary: A sprawling arcade game where ancient and tree environments host puzzle-based combat against guards, driving an evolve-to-unify arc.
instructions: WASD or Arrow keys move the player through the arena., Shift triggers a solve burst for repositioning., Space converts puzzles and ember pressure into crowd control.

hud.objective: Use puzzles and ember to survive guard patrols, secure relic routes, and turn each run into evolve, unify progress.

overlay.startCopy:
A sprawling arcade game where ancient and tree environments host puzzle-based combat against guards, driving an evolve-to-unify arc.

Navigate tight corridors while solving environmental puzzles to disable guards before they engage.

Manage resources like embers in an evolve-to-unify system that unlocks new abilities over time.

Evolve into a more powerful form by clearing stronger enemies, gradually shifting from evasion to dominance.

content.hook: A sprawling arcade game where ancient and tree environments host puzzle-based combat against guards, driving an evolve-to-unify arc.
